author: CMDJojo
body:
Hello again!
Yesterday I asked for unbanning, and I know that I have cheated a bit in that game. I am so so so so so sorry for this and I love the avicus server. I know that it was a dumb idea from me to test that, and I want to get unbanned... Can you change the ban to mabe a 1-month temp-ban or so? I've learnt this now, I will never ever do this again. Please think about it, I were just a curious player that wanted to test that ONCE IN ONE GAME... I know that you wont unban me, but please please think about it. I will be really happy if you decide to unban me or change the ban to a temp-ban or so... Please...

Best regards CMDJojo

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

You are responsible for actions and we cannot simply let it slide. We appreciate your honesty, however fly hacking warrants a permanent ban. Feel free to appeal in a few months if you can explain to us why you should be unbanned.

Regards,
Mango_
